newsitem.title: USA: Arden Realty says files to sell 10 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Arden Realty says files to sell 10 mln shrs.

text.p: Arden Realty Inc said Thursday it has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission regarding the sale of 10 million shares of common stock.
The company said it would use the proceeds to complete the purchase of nine Southern California office properties, eight of which are under contract and one of which is subject to a letter of intent.
The company also said it would use the proceeds to repay borrowings under its recently amended $300 million credit facility with Wells Fargo Bank.
The company's recently completed $175 million mortgage financing would remain in place after the offering.
The company said it expects the offering, which will be made only by means of a prospectus, to occur in mid-July.
